evidence: Amorphous FePO4 was deposited at 300 °C by using ferrocene (FeCp2), ozone (O3), trimethyl phosphate (TMPO), and distilled water (H2O) as precursors in a Savannah 100 ALD system (Cambridge Nanotech, USA). The deposition of FePO4 was achieved by following a sequence of FeCp2 pulse (1 s) – purge (10 s) – O3 pulse (1 s) – purge (10 s) – TMPO pulse (2 s) – purge (10 s) – purge (10 s) – H2O pulse (1 s) – purge (10 s).
